text:
maria_cs: FYI — Kyoto Labs just pinged support. Their Dedicated pool was suspended by collections after an overdue invoice. They say they uploaded a PO and a VAT exemption cert; claim card decline didn't actually go through. Need unblock + next steps. Invoice 2026-0487.

billing-bot: automated: invoice 2026-0487 marked PAST_DUE -> dunning triggered -> suspension executed (policy: 7d overdue). Payment attempts: 3.

sara-t: pulling records. Invoice 2026-0487 shows tax code EU-VAT-20 applied. Customer uploaded a VAT document on 2026-03-04 (after due 2026-03-01). PO metadata not attached: no PO number in order object.

johnm: Customer insists they uploaded PO via portal on Mar 2 and that portal showed attachment success. They also said finance tried company card but got "card declined" popup — but no gateway decline recorded?

kevin-ops: can we do a temp re-enable while we sort billing? What's policy for Dedicated customers on suspension hold?

sara-t: policy allows single-day grace hold for enterprise/critical accounts if AM requests and finance approved. Need CH override from Billing team.

emma-legal: VAT exemption requires KYC on the cert before we can remove VAT from an existing invoice. We can accept provisional exemption for service continuity but must later adjust invoices if cert valid.

maria_cs: customer asks to be live today — impact to their production workflows. John, can you confirm their SLA tier?

johnm: they're enterprise, SLA critical. I'll ask for a portal screenshot and the PO filename. Also requesting a payment method proof (last4) so we can reconcile.

sara-t: I've started a Billing Hold override: CH-4591. If ops flips the hold flag we can unsuspend immediately and mark invoice as "under review". We'll re-run card capture once PO/ VAT validated.

kevin-ops: preparing release. Command we use: 
```
PATCH /internal/accounts/kyoto-labs/flags
{ "suspension_hold": true, "hold_reason": "billing_override_CH-4591", "expires_at": "2026-03-05T23:59:00Z" }
```

billing-bot: gateway report snippet: 
```
attempt_1: DECLINED - cvv_mismatch
attempt_2: DECLINED - insufficient_funds
attempt_3: DECLINED - do_not_honor
```

maria_cs: I'll request customer to re-upload the PO (preferably with PO number in filename) and to try alternate card or have AP reach out to their bank. I'll attach their screenshot here when they send it.

sara-t: once we get PO file and VAT cert, finance will: 1) validate VAT cert 2) if exempt, issue invoice adjustment (credit) and mark original as disputed 3) if card capture succeeds, clear dunning and close CH-4591. Please wait for finance sign-off before any final billing changes.

emma-legal: note: if VAT cert is retrospective and we credit, make sure we create audit note with cert id and adjustment reason; tax team will need that for EU filings.

johnm: customer sent portal screenshot (uploaded_PO_kl332.pdf) and says filename included PO KL-PO-332. Upload time shows 2026-03-02 14:08 UTC in their screenshot. Attaching image next.

sara-t: screenshot received. portal logs show an upload event 2026-03-02 for user id 78321 but the file failed server-side virus scan and wasn't attached to order metadata (file status: quarantined). That explains missing PO.

maria_cs: ok — customer unaware of quarantine. I'll explain and ask them to re-upload. Also ask they send the VAT cert to billing@redwood.com directly.

kevin-ops: release executed. Flag set to suspension_hold=true, expires 2026-03-05T23:59:00Z. Service re-enabled at 1792004200.

billing-bot: note: suspension_lifted for account kyoto-labs by kevin-ops (override CH-4591) at 1792004200.

sara-t: thanks. Finance will hold collection actions while we validate docs. If VAT cert valid, we'll do credit adj and update invoice. If card still fails, we'll request bank transfer / PO+wire.

emma-legal: I'll review the cert when billing shares it. Quick reminder: we can't retroactively mark invoice as VAT-exempt without documentation; do provisional enable under "service continuity".

maria_cs: customer happy to re-upload and try alternate card. They've asked for a note confirming no further suspension until EOD. John, can you confirm with them?

johnm: confirmed with customer; they'll re-upload in next 30m and email billing@. I'll keep this thread updated.

sara-t: I'll add auditing tags: [CH-4591], [kyoto-labs], [vat-review]. Finance point: sara-t.

maria_cs: closing loop for now — ops unsuspended, finance reviewing, legal on standby. Will update when docs arrive. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: automated: thread flagged for follow-up at 2026-03-05T09:00:00Z.

johnm: uploaded PO received by billing@ at 2026-03-02T15:10 UTC, email shows attachment KL-PO-332.pdf. Customer also attempted card again and got success on attempt 4 (last4 4242).

sara-t: capturing payment now. If successful we'll clear dunning and mark invoice as paid; if not, escalate to collections.

billing-bot: payment_capture: SUCCESS txn_89234 at 1792004599.

sara-t: payment posted. closing CH-4591 after reconciling VAT cert validity. If VAT valid, we will issue a credit note within 3 business days.

maria_cs: thanks team — customer back online, they appreciated quick response. John will follow up re: credit note.

johnm: will confirm once credit note done.

maria_cs: thread resolved for now.
